authorization: User explicitly accepted MR3-P1C and instructed execution of P2A.
scope: Native Gazebo pilot, exactly three robots per environment, no 2D or gateway.
freeze_binding: All stages use one clean committed/pushed freeze, recorded by metadata.json; code changes stop this plan and require a new version.

stages.name: minimal
stages.purpose: Actual native observations, masked network action selection, external truncation and clean closure followed by real GPU PPO update/checkpoint. No 95% credit.

stages.name: pilot
stages.condition: minimal native and collecting-policy audits pass
stages.purpose: Fixed development-layout learning pilot from scratch; single training seed, no statistical comparison.

stages.name: development_validation
stages.condition: pilot produces a finite frozen final checkpoint without infrastructure errors
stages.checkpoint_selection: final only, no validation-driven selection or tuning
stages.purpose: Three deterministic mask-aware development episodes under unchanged 95%/300s/schema4 gates; all failures retained. Not unseen-layout generalization.

wall_budget: Sample cutoff at next request boundary; in-flight request, genuine stop/closure and final update measured separately in total actual wall time.
retries: none; infrastructure failure stops run/remaining stages, preserve prefix and diagnose
task_failures: count and preserve, never replace or change gates
success_boundary: Actual optimizer updates alone do not complete P2A. Must demonstrate frozen 95% task and learning/coordination evidence; otherwise remain in P2A and report diagnosis.
evaluation_split: Development only; no held-out/test/confirmation layouts or seeds used.
evidence: Complete native records, tensor/mask rollouts, sampling log probabilities, explicit dt/GAE/returns, initial/per-update/final checkpoints and hashes, all process closure receipts, resource samples and independent offline native/scalar/policy audit.
supersedes: v1 minimal native success and original auditor-binding failure remain preserved. The corrected offline audit passes; v2 uses declared research training seed41 and reruns all native stages under a new pushed source freeze.
changes: Explicit accepted-status task document pins; no task machine config, world, native runtime, reward, mask or safety gate change.
